metadata.freshness: same source snapshot as current gallery; 87 configurations available, gallery uses 3 efforts and only 2 skills
metadata.metric: per-skill peak normalized XP/min; mean ln(1+rate) aggregate is dimensionless and not a percentage
metadata.tools_scaffold: Harbor coding agent, TypeScript rs-sdk, wiki files; individual harness/model/effort config must remain distinct
metadata.date_notes: container/agent timestamps per skill are evaluation evidence; releaseDate metadata is not run date
metadata.cost_notes: Source tokenUsage.costUsd is reported API-equivalent/token-derived cost; may not equal actual OAuth/subscription spend. Keep paired skill run. No API-price substitution performed. Long-context surcharges may be omitted.
metadata.time_notes: durationSeconds is tracker duration; container start/finish gives wall time including execution/overhead, not inference-only latency
metadata.comparability_warning: Runs span changing harness/container recipes, dates and settings. Do not treat all 87 as controlled same-version model ranking. One selected trial per skill, no uncertainty intervals. Old/new 10m/15m/30m tracks must not be merged. Exact executed SDK/container digest absent.

protocol.evaluation_track: 30-minute skills; woodcutting and mining kept separate
protocol.version: No formal benchmark version in result; recipe at source commit uses rs-agent-benchmark:v71
protocol.score_formula: round_half_up(max((raw_XP_i - raw_XP_k) / (elapsed_ms_i - elapsed_ms_k) * 60000 / 200)); nearest earlier sample &gt;=12000 ms back
protocol.scoring_clock: Tracker elapsedMs within intended 1800-second window; fixed sample boundaries, not arbitrary sliding windows
tools: TypeScript rs-sdk with BotActions and BotSDK
protocol.model_unit: openai/gpt-6.1-sol + Codex OAuth + explicit reasoning effort + harness + one skill run
protocol.sdk_commit_status: Docker recipe writes SDK SHA inside runtime image; published model JSON lacks it

starting_state.source: First recorded sample in each selected trial

protocol.comparability_status: Exploratory within same skill, date and task recipe; exact executed SDK/container digest and CLI version unverified
protocol.selection: Two skills, three explicit effort levels of launch-day GPT-6.1 Sol; latest valid published trial per model/skill, not all attempts
missing: Executed rs-sdk commit and image digest
Exact Codex CLI version (author states &gt;=0.159 needed)
Actual cash cost for OAuth plan
limitations: One selected run is not a mean or stable ranking
Wall time includes game execution and latency
API-equivalent token-cost estimate excludes compute and subscription costs
Historical rate card ignores long-context surcharges
No causal claim about reasoning effort from single trials
